## Use Noto Mono in VS Code

Paste this into your settings to set Noto Mono for the editor. The fallbacks are the same ones CodeFont writes.

{
  "editor.fontFamily": "'Noto Sans Mono', 'JetBrains Mono', 'SF Mono', Monaco, 'Cascadia Code', 'Roboto Mono', monospace"
}

## About the Noto Mono coding font

The monospaced version of Google's Noto font family. Noto Mono is a free monospace coding font without programming ligatures.

Noto Mono is hosted on Google Fonts, so the specimen above renders without installing anything locally. It is one of the 95 families in the CodeFont catalog.

## Noto Mono FAQ

### Is Noto Mono free?

Yes. Noto Mono is free to use; check the official source for the exact licence terms.

### Does Noto Mono support ligatures?

No. Noto Mono has no programming ligatures, so sequences such as -> and != are drawn as separate characters.

### Where can I get Noto Mono?

Noto Mono is available from Google Fonts and GitHub. The download links are listed in the Where to get section above.
